learning_notes.zh: 通胀预期，指家庭、企业或市场对未来通胀的预估。
learning_notes.example: Inflation expectations can shape wage bargaining and bond yields.

learning_notes.zh: 实际收益率，名义利率扣除通胀预期后的收益率。
learning_notes.example: Gold often reacts more to real yields than nominal yields.

learning_notes.zh: 市场结构，指交易、托管、清算、ETF、监管等制度安排。
learning_notes.example: Crypto market structure rules can affect institutional participation.

learning_notes.zh: AI 资本开支，指云厂商和科技公司投入 AI 基建的支出。
learning_notes.example: AI capex guidance can move semiconductor stocks.

learning_notes.zh: 终端利率，市场预期本轮加息周期的最高政策利率。
learning_notes.example: A higher terminal rate can pressure growth stocks.

learning_notes.zh: 软着陆，指通胀回落而经济避免明显衰退。
learning_notes.example: Markets often rally when data support a soft landing.
